name: Blockade Narrows

stars.name: Narrows Alpha
stars.notes: Hot, bright primary whose wide circumbinary habitable band makes the system worth holding.

stars.name: Narrows Beta
stars.notes: Detached white dwarf companion on a wide orbit; inert, but its gravity defines the system's narrow stable lanes.

planets.name: Emberlock
planets.notes: Circumbinary furnace world used as a bombarding target by blockade gunnery schools.

planets.name: Cordwain
planets.notes: Automated rare-earth extraction rigs, abandoned twice and stripped twice by retreating garrisons.

planets.name: Threnody
planets.notes: Occupied breadbasket world; its grain feeds two sectors, and its cities have been under martial law for nine years.

planets.name: The Gauntlet
planets.notes: Cratered proving ground where occupation troops train against live-fire drone swarms.

planets.name: Twin Toll
planets.notes: Refueling giant astride the only stable exit lane; every passing hull pays the blockade levy at its skim stations.

planets.name: Hoarfrost Line
planets.notes: Outer sentinel world carrying the blockade's long-range detection fence.

asteroid_belts.name: Tollman Belt
asteroid_belts.notes: Smugglers thread its dust shoals to dodge checkpoint scans; the occupation calls these runs 'paying the other toll.'

stations.name: Checkpoint Meridian
stations.notes: The blockade's spine: a fortified inspection ring that no sanctioned vessel may pass without full manifest review.

stations.name: Threnody Down
stations.notes: Occupation garrison hub; its brig barges are said to be the only structures on Threnody always at capacity.

faction_control.notes: Formally Coalition-held after reconquest, but Threnody's independence cells sabotage convoys weekly and no one controls the Tollman Belt after dark.

history: Charted as the only stable corridor between the Sunder Corridor and the frontier sectors, it was fought over before it was even named.
Threnody declared independence during the Secession; the nine-year reconquest that followed ended in occupation, not peace.
The current blockade exists to strangle the insurgency — and, quietly, to tax every grain shipment leaving the world it governs.
description: Two mismatched suns — a bright F primary and a dead white dwarf — pin six planets into a handful of stable orbits, and every one of those orbits commands the corridor's only clean exit lane. The system looks like a funnel because it is one.

Whoever holds Blockade Narrows holds the throat between two sectors, which is why the Coalition never left after the reconquest. Checkpoint Meridian inspects, levies, and delays all traffic; Twin Toll's skim stations refuel it; Threnody feeds the armies doing both. Traffic is steady but slow, every hull logged, searched, and stamped.

For traders, the system is a necessary ordeal; for smugglers, the Tollman Belt is a lottery with lethal odds. The deeper mystery is Threnody itself: the resistance keeps striking targets it should not know exist, and Occupation Intelligence cannot determine who — or what inside the blockade — is telling them.
